stories.title: Gemini starts operating Mac apps in the background
stories.summary: Google is rolling out computer use in its Mac app to eligible paid users in the U.S., initially in English. A separate background window handles clicks and typing across apps, files and websites.
stories.insight: A workflow spanning campaign files and browser tabs is a practical test of where human intervention is still needed.

stories.title: HeyGen connects Ideogram 4.6 images to Avatar 6
stories.summary: HeyGen says Ideogram 4.6 is available for image generation and targeted edits, with a path from the edited image into Avatar 6 animation.
stories.insight: Teams can test whether a character stays consistent as its clothing, scene and motion change.

stories.title: OpenAI explains how GPT-6.2 preserves reasoning across calls
stories.summary: Reasoning items in the Responses API are tied to the preceding conversation. OpenAI advises appending turns instead of editing the earlier history, which can invalidate later reasoning items.
stories.insight: Teams running long agent workflows can review history handling before comparing cache hits and task costs.

stories.title: Genie 4 brings editable worlds to Project Genie
stories.summary: Eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers can use Genie 4 through Project Genie, with native audio, live environment edits, a creation assistant and a gallery for sharing and remixing.
stories.insight: For interactive campaign prototypes, edit latency and reproducibility matter alongside the initial visual impression.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Neon targets faster completion of complex work
stories.summary: Google is rolling out Neon across its API and eligible Gemini and Antigravity plans, positioning it for demanding coding, knowledge and science workflows.
stories.insight: A representative task with several revisions can reveal more about delivery quality and cost than a standalone benchmark score.

stories.title: Mistral highlights local and cloud coding in Vibe Desktop
stories.summary: Mistral's desktop app supports macOS and Windows, bringing local repository sessions and remote coding environments into one interface for following and reviewing agent work.
stories.insight: Connection to existing tooling, review quality and recovery after interruption are useful criteria for a team trial.

stories.title: OpenAI and AMD report model-assisted chip design gains
stories.summary: OpenAI describes using models to revise hardware descriptions and evaluate power, performance and area trade-offs on AMD designs and its own inference chip, with conventional engineering checks.
stories.insight: The workflow illustrates how specialist verification tools can turn generated proposals into reviewable engineering results.

stories.title: OpenAI publishes an update on AI-assisted research
stories.summary: OpenAI's internal measurements show agents tackling longer research tasks while people remain involved in the development process. The report also tracks growing human effort on safety and alignment.
stories.insight: Independent completion rates and the human review budget should be measured together when evaluating workplace automation.

stories.title: Anthropic begins Nasdaq trading and reiterates its mission
stories.summary: Anthropic started Nasdaq trading on November 19. In remarks that day, CEO Dario Amodei discussed scientific applications, public benefit and the company's approach to safe development and deployment.
stories.insight: Future disclosures offer a way to follow how commercial expansion, research spending and stated commitments evolve.

stories.title: HeyGen shares a blinded comparison of avatar providers
stories.summary: HeyGen reports that Avatar 6 led its comparison of personal and stock avatars, in which creators watched matching scripts without seeing the provider names. The result is a vendor-reported evaluation.
stories.insight: A blinded test with a brand's own script can help assess movement and lip sync on the work it actually needs.
